subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should this Telegram/ACP completed-action confabulation report be solved in core, handed off to a ClawHub claim-verification plugin, or split between a narrow core delivery fix and plugin-level broad claim verification?
rationale: Current source shows only prompt guidance and narrow private-final diagnostics, while VISION.md favors plugin ownership for optional policy engines; choosing where fail-closed verification belongs changes privacy, delivery, and plugin API policy.

options.title: Split Core And Plugin Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open for narrow Telegram/ACP source-channel semantics and live repro, and route broad success-claim ledger verification to ClawHub/plugin work unless an API gap appears.

options.title: Make Core Verify Claims
options.body: Define a built-in finalization policy that blocks or warns on unsupported success claims across Telegram/ACP and other surfaces, accepting the larger product and compatibility footprint.

options.title: Close As Plugin Scope
options.body: Treat all claim verification here as already covered by the ClawHub direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68051 and close this issue after documenting the plugin handoff.

recommendation.title: Split Core And Plugin Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for narrow Telegram/ACP source-channel semantics and live repro, and route broad success-claim ledger verification to ClawHub/plugin work unless an API gap appears.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available policy signal from the related ClawHub close and recent ACP/plugin-hook history.
